v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Exaltáte * Dóminum Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto eius.
text.en: Exalt ye the Lord * our God, and worship him upon his holy mountain.

text.la: Éripe me * de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi.
text.en: Deliver me from my enemies, * O Lord, to thee have I fled.

text.la: Benedixísti, * Dómine, terram tuam: remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ.
text.en: Lord, thou hast blessed thy land; * Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people.

text.la: In Dómino iustificábitur * et laudábitur omne semen Israël.
text.en: In the Lord * shall all the seed of Israel be justified and praised.

text.la: Fratres: Qui gloriátur, in Dómino gloriétur. Non enim qui seípsum comméndat, ille probátus est; sed quem Deus comméndat.
text.en: Brothers: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord. For not he who commendeth himself, is approved, but he, whom God commendeth.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Símile est regnum cælórum * hómini negotiatóri quærénti bonas margarítas: invénta una pretiósa, dedit ómnia sua, et comparávit eam.
text.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchantman * seeking goodly pearls, who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

text.la: Exáudi nos, Deus, salutáris noster: ut sicut de beátæ Terésiæ Vírginis tuæ festivitáte gaudémus; ita cæléstis eius doctrínæ pábulo nutriámur, et piæ devotiónis erudiámur afféctu.
text.en: Hear us, O God, our Savior, that as we rejoice in the feast of Blessed Teresa, thy Virgin, so we may be fed with the food of her heavenly teaching and be instructed in the affection of pious devotion.
